description: This file defines the NodeFaqDownload class, which is a model representing FAQ download nodes in the Goteo project. It includes methods for retrieving and manipulating FAQ download data, including localized fields, listing, and saving records.

classes.name: NodeFaqDownload
classes.description: Model for FAQ download nodes, including properties for node data, and methods for data retrieval, saving, and validation.

methods.name: getLangFields
methods.description: Returns the list of fields that are localized and need language-specific handling.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Fetches FAQ download node data by ID, including localized fields.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of FAQ download nodes based on filters, supports pagination and counting, with localization.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Persists the current node object to the database, performing insert or update.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the node data, ensuring required fields like title are set.
